mapper.select: select coalesce(v.viewCount, 0) as viewCount, coalesce(f.favoriteCount, 0) as favoriteCount, coalesce(c.commentCount, 0) as commentCount, cast(julianday('now') - julianday(A.created_at) as integer) as daysSincePublished from articles A left join ( select article_id, count(*) as viewCount from article_views group by article_id ) v on v.article_id = A.id left join ( select article_id, count(*) as favoriteCount from article_favorites group by article_id ) f on f.article_id = A.id left join ( select article_id, count(*) as commentCount from comments group by article_id ) c on c.article_id = A.id where A.slug = #{slug}

select A.id as articleId, A.slug as articleSlug, A.title as articleTitle, A.description as articleDescription, A.created_at as articleCreatedAt, count(AF.user_id) as favoriteCount, U.id as userId, U.username as userUsername, U.bio as userBio, U.image as userImage from articles A inner join article_favorites AF on AF.article_id = A.id left join users U on U.id = A.user_id where AF.article_id in ( select af2.article_id from article_favorites af2 inner join articles a2 on a2.id = af2.article_id where a2.created_at >= datetime('now', '-7 days') ) and A.created_at >= datetime('now', '-7 days') group by A.id, A.slug, A.title, A.description, A.created_at, U.id, U.username, U.bio, U.image order by favoriteCount desc limit 10
